title: Lineup and budget overrides on every launch path (Roadmap launch, ork run)

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
ork has the pieces of a lineup and budget override but only one door to them. The daemon accepts `lineup` and `budgets` on `run.plan`, `run.start` and `wave.start` (`internal/daemon/runs.go:47-56`, applied at `:426-467`; adj 134 run.launch-wire). The Waves view edits them with `e` (`internal/tui/lineup.go`, `docs/dashboard.md:1180-1215`). `ork run` has no flag for them (`internal/cli/run.go:48-50`), `ork wave start` has none (`internal/cli/wave.go:90-93`), and the Roadmap launch has no editor (`internal/tui/launch.go:204` builds `RunParams` with no `Lineup` or `Budgets`). So the owner still needs the outer session to pick a lineup for a launch from the Roadmap or the shell.

Parity rows: 2.3 (pick the lineup for one slice) and gap 1 of the prioritized list in `docs/orchestrator-parity.md` (from S165).

Owner decisions that apply:
- An edit applies to that run only; the matrix and the registry are unchanged (adj 133 lineup.override-scope).
- The edits travel as the full lineup per role plus budgets, and the plan echoes them so the Expected check covers them (adj 134 run.launch-wire). The daemon needs no change for this slice.
- The editor is cycle plus custom fields (adj 136 ui.lineup-editor).
- The role matrix is slicer's. ork reads it through slicer's CLI and never edits it (`docs/boundaries.md`). This slice adds no write to the matrix.
- Owner policy: one Codex slot at a time and a Claude sonnet-high stand-in when Codex is out of credits. A launch override is how the owner applies it by hand today. The automatic version is S169, not this slice.

Slicer check (`slicer find "lineup override" --root ../slicer`): no match. Slicer's `relay-roles recommend` is what ork already calls; slicer has no launch-time override and no ork-side flag.

Design (*proposed*):
- `ork run` and `ork wave start` get the flags `--implementer`, `--reviewer`, `--architect` (each `VENDOR:MODEL:EFFORT`, repeatable; the entries given, in order, are the whole chain for that role, first entry primary; `--architect off` drops the architect), plus `--budget-minutes N` and `--budget-tokens N` (0 means the project default, as in the Waves editor). On `ork wave start` the flags apply to every item. The gate follows the reviewer and has no flag; the UI pass row has none (as in the daemon, `internal/daemon/runs.go:427`).
- The Roadmap launch confirmation takes `e`: it opens the same lineup editor as Waves, saves to a new plan with the overrides, and returns to the confirmation. `y` then starts with the overrides and the edited plan as Expected.

Not in this slice: per-item flags on `ork wave start`, writing overrides back to the matrix or registry, any daemon wire change, the vendor cap and vendor-out memory (S169), the spec check (S167).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestRunLineupFlagsSendLineupOnPlanAndStart` (`internal/cli/run_test.go`): `--implementer codex:gpt-6.1-sol:medium --implementer claude:sonnet:high` sends a two-entry implementer chain on `run.plan` and `run.start`, and `run.start` carries the printed plan as Expected.
- `TestRunArchitectOffSendsEmptyArchitect`: `--architect off` sends `lineup.architect` as an empty list.
- `TestRunBudgetFlagsSendBudgets`: `--budget-minutes 20 --budget-tokens 0` sends `budgets {20,0}`.
- `TestRunWithoutLineupFlagsSendsNoOverrides`: the `run.plan` params JSON has no `lineup` and no `budgets` key.
- `TestRunLineupFlagUsageErrors`: a value with fewer than three parts, an empty part, `--architect off` plus an entry, and a negative budget each exit 2 with no daemon call.
- `TestWaveStartLineupFlagsApplyToEveryItem` (`internal/cli/wave_test.go`): both items' `run.plan` and `wave.start` params carry the same overrides.
- `TestLaunchConfirmEKeyOpensLineupEditor` (`internal/tui/launch_test.go`): `e` at the launch confirmation opens the editor seeded from the plan; `esc` returns to the same confirmation and calls no Plan.
- `TestLaunchLineupSaveReplansWithOverrides`: save calls `Plan` once with the changed role and budgets, shows `pending: run.plan`, then the new plan's confirmation.
- `TestLaunchLineupReplanErrorKeepsOldPlan`: a Plan error shows verbatim, keeps the old plan and old overrides, and `y` still starts the old plan.
- `TestLaunchStartCarriesOverridesAndEditedPlan`: `y` calls `Start` with `Lineup`, `Budgets` and the edited plan as Expected.
- `TestLaunchUnchangedEditorDoesNotPlan`: save with no change calls no Plan.
- `TestLaunchLineupGolden`: the editor on the launch at 100x30, colour and mono (`launch-lineup-100x30-color.txt`, `launch-lineup-100x30-mono.txt`).
- `TestWavesLineupStillWorksAfterEditorExtraction` (`internal/tui/lineup_test.go`): a run of the existing Waves editor flow (cycle, custom, architect drop, budgets) gives the same params as before.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
UI slice: UI pass (r14). Test-first: write the tests above, see them fail, then:
1. `internal/cli/lineup.go` (new): `type lineupFlags` with `register(fs *flag.FlagSet)` and `apply(p *daemon.RunParams) error`. `--implementer`, `--reviewer`, `--architect` are repeatable `flag.Value`s; each value is `VENDOR:MODEL:EFFORT` (vendor before the first colon, effort after the last, model between). `--architect off` alone gives an empty chain. `--budget-minutes` and `--budget-tokens` default to unset; negative is a usage error. All parse errors are exit 2 before any daemon call (`o.usage`, `internal/cli/run.go:54`). The daemon keeps checking vendor, model and effort (`internal/daemon/runs.go:438-444`).
2. `internal/cli/run.go`: call `register` beside the flags at `:48-51`; call `apply` on `params` at `:106`, before `run.plan` (`:108`). The same params, with `Expected = &plan` (`:133`), go to `run.start`, so the echoed plan covers the overrides (adj 134).
3. `internal/cli/wave.go`: same, on every `p` at `:145` (flags apply to all items).
4. `internal/cli/cli.go:42-46`: add the flags to the usage text of `run` and `wave start`.
5. `internal/tui/lineup.go`: extract from `openLineup` (`:66-72`) `newLineupEditor(item, plan)`; from `lineupKey` (`:77-153`) a host-free `editLineup(e, msg)` that returns none, save, discard or quit; from `saveLineup` (`:155-195`) `lineupOverrides(e, p) (daemon.RunParams, changed, ok)` (budget check, `reflect.DeepEqual` against the plan); and make `lineupBody` (`:197`) take the editor and the item title instead of reading `m.waves`. Waves calls the same helpers; its behaviour and goldens do not change.
6. `internal/tui/launch.go`: add `launchEdit` to `launchStage` (`:20-27`) and `lineup *lineupEditor` plus `prev *daemon.RunPlan` to `launchState` (`:29-38`). Add `openLaunchLineup()`: clears `m.confirm`, seeds the editor from `l.plan`, stage `launchEdit`. Save: `l.params` gets the overrides, stage `launchPlanPending`, `live.Plan(ctx, l.params)` as at `:150-157`. In `applyLaunch` (`:235-256`), a Plan error with `l.prev != nil` restores the old plan and confirmation and shows the error verbatim; the first plan's error still drops the launch (`:242-246`).
7. `internal/tui/model.go`: in the confirm branch (`:507-523`) add `e` when `m.confirm.verb == "launch"`; route keys to the launch editor before `launchKey` (`:537`); add the launch editor to the paste case (`:453-461`) (`projectTextEntry` already covers any open launch, `internal/tui/projects.go:24`). `runAction` (`:1120-1138`) gets `lineup` and `budgets`, set at `launch.go:254`; `startLaunch` (`launch.go:204`) puts them in `RunParams`.
8. `internal/tui/view.go:83-99` and `internal/tui/keys.go:251-252,268-290`: draw `lineupBody` for the launch editor; the confirm hint gains `e edit lineup` (drop order like `dropRow`), the editor hints are shared with Waves. Keep the confirm prompt `ork run PROJECT ITEM? [y/N] (Enter is No)`; after an edit add the dim words `lineup edited` to the status line, not to the command.
9. Docs: `docs/design.md:166-186` and `:1005-1030` (flags, edit applies to that run only), `docs/dashboard.md:1180-1215` (the editor is shared) and `:1275-1331` (`e` at the launch confirmation), `docs/guide.md` sections 6 and 7 (the "there is no flag" sentences) once S165 has landed.
10. Goldens: `go test ./internal/tui -update`, then review the diff of `testdata/golden/`; only the two new launch-lineup files may appear.
Order: independent of S167 in the CLI; in the TUI do S166 before S167 (both change `internal/tui/launch.go` and the confirm path).
Open: (a) `--implementer` gives the whole chain (recommended: deterministic, can express codex then claude sonnet-high). The other option replaces only the primary and keeps the matrix fallbacks, as the Waves custom entry does, and needs a plan then a re-plan in the CLI. (b) Flags on `ork wave start` apply to all items (recommended). Options: a per-item `ID=` form, or no flags on wave start.

Owner decisions 2026-10-29 (interactive, UI pass round 1): the launch plan (Roadmap confirmation and the ork run plan text) shows a budgets: N min, N tokens row only when budgets were overridden (existing goldens unchanged, as in Waves); esc while an edited replan is pending cancels only the replan and returns to the previous confirmation (hint esc back), as the replan error path does.
